[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Gyala Hatchery | page name suffix=explorable area | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=144 }} The '''Gyala Hatchery''' explorable area is the stretch of Jade Sea that lies between the capital, [[Cavalon]], and the Luxons' [[Gyala Hatchery (outpost)|turtle hatchery]]. It is a somewhat dangerous stretch of land that is littered with [[Naga]] and [[Yeti]] to the north, while the south is dominated by [[Fish]]es, [[Leviathan]]s, and Luxon [[Outcast]]s. == Getting there == Exit north from [[Leviathan Pits]]. Although Gyala Hatchery shares its border with the [[Gyala Hatchery (outpost)|outpost of the same name]], it cannot be reached from there. ==Quest available== *[[Samti Kohlreg]] **[[Messages, Messages [[Irukandji]] encased in a block of jade, in the center of a [[Flooded Jade Mine]]. *Complete exploration of this area will yield about 2.8% to the Canthan [[Cartographer]] title track. **Exploration is best done during [[Gyala Hatchery|the mission]] as, if you avoid triggering the turtles, you can explore most of the area without having to fight anyone. *{{Vanquisher|count = 195|low = 183|high = 209}} **The Outcasts, Fish and Leviathans are hostile to each other. If you let them fight it out, it can reduce enemy numbers by 30-40. [[Jacqui The Reaver]] and [[Reefclaw Ragebound]] also fight, and one of them will eventually kill the other. If Jacqui survives the fight, he might start fighting [[Whyk Steelshell]]'s group next and get killed by them. **There are four spots where hidden [[Oni]] will [[popup]]: ***Two at the large island in the southwestern corner. ***On the large eastern island, Bahnba Shockfoot and his [[Yeti]]s are on a narrow path. Three Oni are on the other parallel path. ***Two more on a spot just north of the previous spot, close to the path of the Naga patrols. ***Two in the northeastern corner. **No foes have [[List of hex removal skills|hex removal]] and all are [[fleshy]], so [[hex spell]]s and [[minion master]]s work well here. {{bug|The northern [[portal]] to the [[Gyala Hatchery (outpost)|Gyala Hatchery's outpost]] is missing the white hazy barrier usually associated with Factions and Prophecies area transitions.}} {{Explorable areas in the Jade Sea}} [[de:Gyala-Brutstätte (Erforschbar)]]
